intro: Aeyaz is a Dubai-based Director of Photography, available to work worldwide, specialising in high-end TV commercials and branded films.
body:
Aeyaz is a Director of Photography based in Dubai, available to work worldwide. He primarily works on high-end TV commercials and feature films, with a body of work spanning the Middle East, Europe, Asia, Africa and the USA.

In 2023, Aeyaz was listed among the Top 3 Cinematographers at the Loeries Awards for Middle East & Africa, recognising his work in commercial cinematography.

With over 15 years of experience across VFX, post-production and cinematography, he brings a unique understanding of the visual process from camera and lighting through to VFX and the final image. His background as a VFX Supervisor and post-production specialist adds an additional perspective to his work as a cinematographer, particularly on visually complex productions.

He has shot campaigns for brands including Pepsi, Samsung, Philips, Saudia Airlines, Dubai Tourism, Coca-Cola, KFC, Nespresso, Etisalat and Saudi Telecom and has worked with several international celebrities, athletes and sports personalities across a wide range of commercial productions.

In 2025, Aeyaz made his feature-film debut as Director of Photography with Sarkeet, an Indian (Malayalam) feature film. The film marked his move into long-form narrative cinematography, alongside his continued work in international commercials.
